events.comment: The items of the shops are added by actions when the scene starts. The saved levels of the items are loaded after.

The 100 stickers of the market are made in a variable, then added at once. An item is a structure with Id, Title, Description, Price, Icon and Category (and optionally MaxLevel, Currency, IsLocked...).
The money and the items of the shops are saved in the storage, and loaded when the game starts.
The saved text can be read a bit later: it is applied when it is there.
"Restart" restarts the game to show that it is saved, "Reset" deletes the save.
The upgrades give more coins per tap, and per second. The "Golden touch" is unlocked when the tap power reaches level 5.
The coin shows the equipped skin.

eventsFunctionsExtensions.name: Gamepads
eventsFunctionsExtensions.shortDescription: Gamepad/controller support: buttons, sticks, triggers, vibration. Mapper behaviors for 2D/3D.
description: Add support for gamepads (or other physical controllers).
It gives access to:
- button presses,
- axis positions and force,
- trigger pressure,
- configurable deadzone,
- vibration,

- automatic "gamepad mapper" behaviors for 2D and 3D movement behaviors (platformer characters, top-down movement, 3D character etc...). Add one of these to the object with the movement behavior (i.e: the player most of the time) and the behavior will then be controlled automatically by the gamepad (it works by reading the gamepad state and simulating controls). No need for additional events to make it work once the behaviors are set up.
The Bomberman-like example handles 4 players with gamepads ([open the project online](https://editor.gdevelop.io/?project=example://goose-bomberman)).

description: A shop to spend the money of the player: upgrades with levels, items bought once or again and again, skins to equip, locked items...
- **Shop dialog**: a title, category tabs, the money of the player and a scrolling list (or grid) of items. It works with the mouse, touchscreens (drag to scroll), keyboards and gamepads.
- **Shop item**: one item (icon, title, description, level pips, price button). Used by the shop dialog, or alone.
- **Currency counter**: an amount with an icon, counting up or down (for any HUD too).
How to use the shop dialog:

1. Add the items with the action "Add an item" (identifier, title, description, price, icon, category), or "Add items from a variable" for many items. Other actions give them levels (upgrades), lock them or make them equipable.
2. Give the money of the player with the action "Money" (like "Coins"), and open the shop.
3. Use the condition "An item was bought" (and the expression "Bought item") to apply the item in the game, and save the money (expression "Money") and the items ("Save the items in a variable").
Locked or too expensive items can not be bought ("A purchase failed", with the reason). For real money or a confirmation, use "Confirmed by events" purchases.
Ready-to-use shops are in the asset store [shops pack](https://editor.gdevelop.io/?initial-dialog=asset-store&asset-pack=shops-shops).

description: A 2D text (with an optional icon) that moves and fades out, then disappears: damage numbers, healing, "+10 coins", experience, "Perfect!", "Game saved"...
It is made for **2D games**: it is a 2D object, placed and moving in the 2D scene. It does not work in 3D: it can not be placed in the 3D world or follow a 3D object.

Create it where the text must appear (its position is its center) and change its text with the action "Text": it plays by itself and is deleted at the end. Its motion (rise, arc to a side, pop or stay), distance and duration are properties.
Ready-to-use floating texts are in the asset store [floating texts pack](https://editor.gdevelop.io/?initial-dialog=asset-store&asset-pack=floating-texts-floating-texts).
